name: Steady Shot
description: A carefully aimed shot that deals reliable damage.

name: Piercing Arrow
description: Fire an arrow that penetrates multiple enemies.

name: Explosive Arrow
description: Fire an arrow that explodes on impact.

name: Rain of Arrows
description: Fire a volley of arrows into the air to rain down on enemies.

name: Headshot
description: Aim for the head for massive critical damage.

name: Triple Shot
description: Fire three arrows in quick succession.

name: Poison Arrow
description: Fire an arrow coated with deadly poison.

name: Ice Arrow
description: Fire an arrow that freezes the target.

name: Fire Arrow
description: Fire an arrow that ignites the target.

name: Marking Shot
description: Mark a target, increasing all damage they take.

name: Evasive Roll
description: Roll to the side to dodge attacks.

name: Concussive Shot
description: Fire a shot that dazes the target.

name: Snipe
description: Take careful aim for a powerful long-range shot.

name: Scatter Shot
description: Fire a spread of arrows hitting multiple targets.

name: Fleet Foot
description: Increase movement speed temporarily.

name: Trick Shot
description: Fire an arrow that ricochets between enemies.

name: Silencing Shot
description: Fire an arrow that silences spellcasters.

name: Volley
description: Rapidly fire arrows at all enemies in sight.

name: Arrow Storm
description: Create a devastating storm of arrows.

name: Kill Shot
description: Execute a low health enemy with a lethal shot.
